nodes.name: deploy.sh
nodes.summary: Production deployment script with multi-step orchestration, automatic rollback, and trading safety layer validation. Handles Docker Compose stack lifecycle with database reset and environment validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Shell script using safe .env parsing (no sourcing) and deploy-step tracking for fault recovery.

nodes.name: health_check.sh
nodes.summary: Comprehensive health probe for all running services in the stack—infrastructure, APIs, scheduler, bot, validation engines, and observability components. Provides colored output and exit code signaling.

nodes.name: install_autopush.sh
nodes.summary: Idempotent git hook installer that sets up automatic push-to-origin on commit and fallback cron-based push every 30 minutes, preserving existing crontab entries.

nodes.name: nightly_claude_diagnose.sh
nodes.summary: Nightly autonomous diagnostic runner that invokes the /diagnose skill headless via Claude Code, generates system health reports in markdown, and posts verdicts to Discord watchdog channel.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Claude Code headless with restricted tool set for autonomous diagnostics; Discord webhook integration for alert delivery.

nodes.name: preflight.sh
nodes.summary: Pre-deployment validation gating all stack starts: verifies Docker/Compose installation, .env presence and required secrets, compose config validity, port availability, and SQL schema consistency.
nodes.languageNotes: Defensive .env parsing handles unquoted values with spaces and inline comments exactly as Docker Compose does.

nodes.name: sql_check_allow.txt
nodes.summary: Configuration file for SQL schema validation allowlist, permitting verified false positives from static SQL checker to be suppressed.

nodes.name: _rollback
nodes.summary: Handles deployment failure recovery by rolling back to the last successfully deployed commit and restarting the service stack.

nodes.name: _load_env
nodes.summary: Safe .env file parser that exports key-value pairs without executing arbitrary shell code from environment variable values.

nodes.name: http_check
nodes.summary: HTTP endpoint probe with curl that reports status and extracts health status field from JSON response when present.

nodes.name: container_check
nodes.summary: Docker container health status reporter using docker compose ps, interpreting health states (healthy, unhealthy, starting) with color-coded output.

nodes.name: port_in_use
nodes.summary: Cross-platform port-availability checker using ss/netstat/lsof in order of precedence to detect listening sockets on a given port.
